entrypoint.name: entrypoint
entrypoint.do: case "${ORIGIN#http://}" in "$ORIGIN") h=${ORIGIN#https://};; *) h=${ORIGIN#http://};; esac; case "$h" in "$ORIGIN"|""|*[!A-Za-z0-9.:-]*) echo "ORIGIN '$ORIGIN' is no origin: set it to the scheme and host readers reach the door at, as https://app.example" >&2; exit 1;; esac; set -e -o pipefail; roots=$(caddy adapt --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile | tr , '\n' | grep -o '"root":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u); if [ -n "$roots" ]; then find $roots -type f ! -name '*.etag' -exec sh -c 'set -e; q=$1; shift; for f do h=$(sha256sum < "$f"); printf "$q%s$q" "${h%% *}" > "$f.etag"; done' sh '"' {} +; fi; if [ -f /certs/localhost.pem ]; then export CADDY_TLS='/certs/localhost.pem /certs/localhost-key.pem'; fi; exec caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

toolchain-install.line: RUN cd /opt/bkid && mise trust -y && mise install && mise exec -- sh -c 'cp "$(mise which task)" /usr/local/bin/task && cp "$(mise which depot)" /usr/local/bin/depot'

cmds.do:
set -eu
export DOCKER_HOST_TCP="$DOCKER_HOST"
export DEPOT_DISABLE_OTEL=1
[ -n "$DEPOT_TOKEN" ] && bake="depot bake --project $DEPOT_PROJECT_ID" || bake="docker buildx bake"
pin() { [ -z "$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" ] || find /monorepo -path '*/.bayt/Dockerfile.*' -type f -exec sed -i "$1" {} \; ; }
docker compose --profile '*' config -o /tmp/ci-compose.yaml
docker buildx bake --allow=fs.read=/ -f /tmp/ci-compose.yaml --print ci-visual > /tmp/ci-bake.json
:
for target in ci-visual; do
 case "  " in
 *" $target "*) executor="$bake" ;;
 *) executor="docker buildx bake"; : ;;
 esac
 $executor -f /tmp/ci-bake.json --progress plain --set '*.output=type=cacheonly' ${SAYT_NO_CACHE:+--no-cache --set "*.cache-from=" --set "*.cache-to="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_FROM:+--set "*.cache-from="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_TO:+--set "*.cache-to="} "$target"
done

buildx-instance.name: buildx-instance
buildx-instance.pre:
if [ -n "$BUILDX_BUILDER" ] && [ -n "$BUILDX_INSTANCE" ]; then
  install -d -m 0700 /root/.docker/buildx/instances
  printf '%s' "$BUILDX_INSTANCE" > "/root/.docker/buildx/instances/$BUILDX_BUILDER"
  chmod 0600 "/root/.docker/buildx/instances/$BUILDX_BUILDER"
fi
